description: Pins the deterministic input-stream schema used by oracle reference runs: tic-anchored event records with discriminator-tagged payloads for key-down, key-up, mouse-button-down, mouse-button-up, mouse-move, and quit. Values for scanCode and mouse button index are bounded to match the Chocolate Doom 2.2.1 internal key code space (0-255) and SDL mouse button range (0-4).
